A slip: a printed strip showing the lower part of the card with the corrected game text, meant to be placed over the original card. Published by the Players Committee in its Decipher Errata sheet dated 1 January 2013.

== What changed on the image ==
[[File:ANH-D-deathstartractorbeam-PC-Errata-2013-slip-changes.png|none|900px|Before and after]]
Compared with the printed card [[Death Star Tractor Beam]] (Decipher; Decipher's [[Death Star Tractor Beam (Decipher Errata 1998)|November 1998 errata]] was published as text only): The game text changes: “an opponent's starship present (except” is added after “target”; “starship there (except” is dropped; “Star Cruiser)” becomes “star cruiser)”; “Starship” becomes “Target”; “armor or maneuver.” becomes “defense value.”. The slip adds a black strip below the text box with the title “•Death Star Tractor Beam” and a white italic “E”.

Lower part of the printed card (the area the slip covers, scaled to the slip's width) and the 2013 slip as cut from the sheet at 300 dpi; nothing else is edited.
